title: I Know Whom I Have Believed
description: I Know Whom I Have Believed in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 6 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Daniel Webster Whittle and Elias Nathan, first published in 1883. The tune, I KNOW WHOM I HAVE BELIEVED, is by James McGranahan (1892). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: I know not why_ God's_ won-drous grace To me He hath_ made_ known, Nor why, un-wor_-thy,_ Christ in love Re-deemed me for_ His_ own. But I know Whom I have be-liev-èd, And am per-sua-ded that He is ab-le To keep that which I've com-mit-ted Un-to Him a-gainst that day.

lines: I know not why God's wondrous grace
To me He hath made known,
Nor why, unworthy, Christ in love
Redeemed me for His own.

verses.label: Refrain
lines: But I know Whom I have believèd,
And am persuaded that He is able
To keep that which I've committed
Unto Him against that day.
I know not how this saving faith
To me He did impart,
Nor how believing in His Word
Wrought peace within my heart.
I know not how the Spirit moves,
Convincing us of sin,
Revealing Jesus through the Word,
Creating faith in Him.
I know not what of good or ill
May be reserved for me,
Of weary ways or golden days,
Before His face I see.
I know not when my Lord may come,
At night or noonday fair,
Nor if I walk the vale with Him,
Or meet Him in the air.
